verdict.rationale: Bland documents triggers that watch for events and act on them, such as calling a customer when a support case is created. It also supports batch call campaigns from a CSV and post-call webhooks it sends automatically. Together these let event-driven automations run without a human in the loop. missing for 10: details on trigger sources and configuration (only a one-line description), any scheduled or recurring automation capability, and independent or hands-on confirmation that background automations work reliably.
